title: Satiric
summary: SATIR'IC, SATIR'ICAL, adjective [Latin satiricus.] 1. Belonging to satire; conveying satire; as a satiric style. 2. Censorious; severe in language.

inlines.v: SATIR'IC, SATIR'ICAL, adjective [Latin satiricus.] 1. Belonging to satire; conveying satire; as a satiric style. 2. Censorious; severe in language.
